# awscc_route53_traffic_policy (Resource)

Resource Type definition for AWS::Route53::TrafficPolicy. Creates a Route 53 traffic policy, a JSON document that describes how Route 53 responds to DNS queries for a domain name.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `document` (String) The definition of the traffic policy in JSON format.
- `name` (String) The name of the traffic policy.

### Optional

- `comment` (String) Any comments to include about the traffic policy.

### Read-Only

- `arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the traffic policy.
- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.
- `traffic_policy_id` (String) The ID that Amazon Route 53 assigned to the traffic policy when it was created.
- `type` (String) The DNS type of the resource record sets that Amazon Route 53 creates when the traffic policy is used to create a traffic policy instance.
- `version` (Number) The version number that Amazon Route 53 assigned to the traffic policy.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_route53_traffic_policy.example
  identity = {
    arn = "arn"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

#### Optional
